gaps.area: Filter bar: Namespace, Uses, Module controls
gaps.canvas: Instances.dc.html:81-90 and 251-256: Uses, Namespace and Module are <select>s. Their options are every value present: Uses deduplicated and sorted, Namespace and Module via uniq(). Each option is labelled 'value (count)' by opts()/count() at :244-245, counted over all rows.

They are drawn by partials.html:30-32 (input list=datalist), with suggestions only from pages.go:570-575. The filters.go:44-50 params have Values nil, so filters.go:205-211 draws them as text. design.md (archive, 'Filters: URL first') chose free text for uses, namespace and module.
gaps.fix:
Draw Uses, Namespace and Module as selects built from the rows, and keep the free-text matching and URL contract (D14) unchanged. Three constraints the comparer's fix missed:
(a) The live fetch is scoped to the namespace filter (pages.go:124-134), so v.Namespaces holds only the current namespace once one is set. Namespace options must come from an unscoped list. When that list is locked (InstancesLocked or PackagesLocked), keep a text input so a namespace-only reader can still type a namespace they may read, as the locked panel tells them to.

summaries.platform-shell: I checked the 35 gaps against Main.dc.html, the live screenshots, the templates, the CSS and Go view code, the read API types, DESIGN.md D14 to D18 and the archived redesign design.md. The gap list is mostly right, but three of its claims are wrong. First, the canvas Installed card is not half-width: it is the only item in an auto-fit grid (Main.dc.html:114), so it spans the full width, as live does. Second, the colour tokens do not match token for token. The surface and paper tokens match, but the canvas has a third, darker text shade per tone, and its dark-mode tone values and dark line colour differ from live. Third, the comparer missed two decisions that already apply here. The identity card keeps only Platform facts; Kubernetes version and context belong in the header (redesign design.md "Where the cluster, reader and version live", portal:D18). The contract popover, including its kind, is out of scope under the redesign design.md Non-Goals and portal:D17/OQ25. Status: 29 gaps confirmed (most with corrected category, severity or evidence) and 6 rejected (pure data differences, duplicates, capture artifacts, or not gaps). I added 8 gaps the comparer missed. These are link colour (the canvas draws links in brass text, live in ink with a brass underline), the APPLY prefix on Applied badges and the round dot pills for Health (the canvas uses one square badge style for both), the Instance chip colour in dark mode, mono labels where the canvas uses sans, the Applied word set ("Ready / Not ready" against "Applied / Failed"), the Claimed filter offering raw yes/no, the size and weight of the row-heading links, and the live-only footer. The biggest real differences are still the Status card (a large verdict, a reason line with counts and a "since" time; Reconcile.Since and the registrations carry the data), the 1500px column against the 1840px design, the flowing pills on the Installed card against stacked rows, the tab styling and counts, the events shown as cards against a table with clickable resources, and the drafting-table panel styling (diamonds, corner marks, shadow, blueprint grid). No document records that styling as a decision, and D17 names the reviewed canvas as the target.
summaries.installed:
I checked all 20 gaps against the canvas board, the four Installed screenshots and the live code. 13 hold, 3 of them reclassified. 4 are rejected, and 6 gaps the comparer missed are added.

Main corrections:
- **installed-12 and installed-13 are decided-out, not open gaps.** The canvas draws Applied and Health as same-shape rectangles and words Applied as "Ready" / "Not ready". portal:D3:R1 and the main web-ui spec ("Applied and health are two badges, never one": two separate badges of different shapes, Ready=True shown as "Applied") rule both out.
- **installed-13 had a false claim.** Live Progressing is blue, not brass: `--progressing` is #2458b8 in light and #79a6ff in dark, the same as the canvas.
- **installed-01's fix would break locked readers.** The live page fetches instances and packages scoped to the namespace filter (pages.go:124-134). So a namespace select built from the rows would list only the current namespace. A namespace-only reader whose cluster-wide list is locked would also have no options at all, and the locked panel tells that reader to "filter by a namespace you may read".
- **installed-05's fix had the wrong format for Uses.** The '#Backup' chip is canvas mock notation. The change's design.md shows a contract by its last two path segments with the version, so the chip and option label should use that short form.
- **installed-20 cited only portal:OQ24.** It now also cites portal:D16:R2. Its Module half was not decided and is added as installed-26.

Rejected: installed-14 (the canvas's short option lists are mock data, and its Applied vocabulary conflicts with D3), installed-16 and installed-18 (live-only additions that do not conflict with the design), and the false Progressing-colour part of installed-13.

Added:
- installed-21: per-option counts on every select, not only Namespace, Uses and Module.
- installed-22: search and the text fields apply only on Enter or the Apply button, not as the user types.
- installed-23: the "of M" total shrinks to one namespace when the namespace filter is set.
